instruction.text: This line graph shows the average monthly temperature in the cities of Jakarta and Leeds. Look at the line graph and answer the questions.

atoms.a: What is the difference in average temperature between Jakarta and Leeds in February?
What is the difference in average temperature between Jakarta and Leeds in May?

instruction.text: This line graph shows the number of passengers each day on two different buses. Look at the line graph and answer the questions.

hint.text: Look closely at the units for the vertical axis.

atoms.a: What is the difference in the number of passengers between Bus A and Bus B on Wednesday?
What is the difference in the number of passengers between Bus A and Bus B on Saturday?

instruction.text: This line graph shows the average cost of a weekly shop for two families in different years. Look at the line graph and answer the questions.

hint.text: Try and find out when the cost of the weekly shop increased the most, as this is an indicator for the cost of living. The steeper the line, the higher the increase in price between the years.

atoms.a: Between which years is it likely the cost of living rose the most?
